desc:
Welcome to +1 Jump Pogo ASMR Escape!

⚡ Every jump = +1 Jump  
🦘 Bounce your way across a giant world filled with satisfying ASMR  
🚀 Upgrade your pogo stick and jump higher than ever  
💪 Train your jump power and unlock powerful multipliers  
👥 Bounce alongside friends and other players  
🌍 Become the JUMPIEST player on the server  

🎧 Satisfying ASMR vibes included  
Bounce through squishy toys, butter, gummy bears, matcha, slime, and tons of other satisfying obstacles while enjoying relaxing sounds and colorful environments ✨
